# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability
Please report security issues using GitHub Security Advisories or email 71955351+blue-wind-25@users.noreply.github.com.  
Do not open public issues for vulnerabilities.

## Project Status
JxMake is currently in active development and has not reached a stable release.  
Security reports are still welcome, and fixes will be applied to the development branch.

## Disclosure Policy
- We aim to acknowledge receipt of reports within 72 hours.
- Fixes are targeted as quickly as possible, depending on development priorities.
- A public advisory will be published once a patch is available.

## Safe Harbor
We will not pursue legal action against researchers who report vulnerabilities responsibly and in good faith.
